messages:
maria_cs: Quick draft: customer-facing priming checklist for Harrington (renewal demo). Want it cheeky-short for AE. PTAL.

tom_eng: Drop the minimal knobs and a war-room trigger.

maria_cs: Draft bullets below for AE to run before demo: 

- Why: make demo replies feel instant and repeatable.
- Leads: CS (maria_cs) + Eng (tom_eng).
- 48h: request warm pool (size = 95pct projected concurrency).
- 12h: run prefill job with top demo prompts + any tenant system prompts.
- 1h: run full dry-run with streaming on.

- Customer integration recommendations:
  • prefill_ttl: 3600
  • batch_hint: target=6, max_latency_ms=60
  • enable_stream: true, stream_fallback_ms:200

- Observability: check first-byte latency <150ms, capture 5 prompt traces.
- Survey: 3 q's + opt-in to attach up to 2 anonymized transcripts (consent copy included).
- Escalation: if 95th pct latency >250ms OR hallucination rate spikes -> switch to fallback model variant, notify CS-oncall and infra.

rachel_ae: Can we add an AE one-liner: "Risk: demo sensitivity to latency/quality; mitigation: warm-pool + prefill + quick rollback."

nina_support: Add GDPR consent wording: "I consent to anonymized transcript review for quality improvements." Also tiny.redwood/feedback-harrington link.

tom_eng: Paste prefill curl: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/prefill -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenant":"harrington","prompt":"demo-seed","pool_size":8,"ttl_sec":3600}'
```

infra_bot: Reminder: reserve dedicated slot 2024-11-22T13:00:00Z for tenant 'harrington' — reply :thumbsup: to confirm.

maria_cs: Thanks all. I'll run dry-run Wed 10:00 with tom_eng + nina_support and send the one-pager to AE after. Leaving this thread as the official checklist + snippets + escalation plan. :white_check_mark:
